name: Government T D Medical College, Vandanam (T D Medical College, Alappuzha)
tagline: Alappuzha district's government teaching hospital and primary referral centre
summary: Government T D Medical College (TDMC) at Vandanam is a government-run medical college and teaching hospital serving Alappuzha district with MBBS, postgraduate and superspeciality services.
description: Government T D Medical College, Vandanam (TDMC Alappuzha) is a government teaching hospital and medical college established in 1963. It sits on a large campus at Vandanam and functions as the primary referral centre for Alappuzha district.

TDMC combines undergraduate (MBBS) training, postgraduate and super‑specialty clinical services. The hospital serves a high-volume outpatient population and provides emergency, surgical and specialist inpatient care for the coastal and inland communities of the district.

The college is part of Kerala's public health and medical-education system and is affiliated to the Kerala University of Health Sciences. Visitors (patients and relatives) come for district-level specialist care, diagnostics and referrals; students and trainees come for clinical rotations and teaching.
highlights: Established 1963; one of Kerala's long‑running medical colleges.
Primary government referral hospital for Alappuzha district with broad specialist departments.
MBBS teaching programme with postgraduate and super‑speciality training (MBBS intake 175 seats in recent seat matrices).
PMSSY/superspeciality block houses an active cardiology service and cath lab.
Large campus and on‑site nursing and paramedical training programmes.
District health training centres (rural and urban) support community outreach.

sections.heading: Background
body: TDMC opens in 1963 under local patronage and later becomes a government college; it is administered by the Kerala Department of Health and Family Welfare. The campus at Vandanam grew over decades as hospital departments shifted from the town to the college campus and modern blocks were added.

The college provides undergraduate MBBS education, postgraduate MD/MS and diploma training and select super‑speciality programmes, while the hospital serves as the district referral centre for emergency, surgical and specialist medical care.

sections.heading: Clinical services and departments
body: The hospital hosts a wide range of departments: general medicine and surgery, obstetrics & gynaecology, paediatrics, orthopaedics, ENT, ophthalmology, neurology and neurosurgery, cardiology and cardio‑thoracic surgery, nephrology, oncology support services, radiodiagnosis and clinical laboratories.

A PMSSY/superspeciality block supports advanced cardiology services (OP, ICCU, cath lab and interventional cardiology). The college also runs training courses for allied health professions and operates community training centres for rural and urban health outreach.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Patients and relatives should confirm department timing, OP days and admission procedures with the hospital before travel. For referrals, carry previous medical records, investigation reports and any referral letters.

Visitors find general hospital contact and administrative numbers on the college website and district health pages; for serious emergencies use the hospital emergency reception on arrival. Confirm visiting-hour rules and parking locally before you travel.

latest.text: Seat matrix updates for 2026–27 list TDMC Alappuzha with 175 MBBS seats (as shown in Kerala seat/NEET counselling materials and official prospectus lists).

Alappuzha hospital investigation: a pair of surgical forceps (scissors/artery forceps) reportedly removed from a patient who had surgery at Vandanam in 2021; the state ordered a detailed probe and a medical board was formed to review the incident.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Year-round — hospital services operate all year; plan visits on weekday outpatient days and confirm timings.
visitorInfo.howToReach: TDMC is at Vandanam, about 8–10 km south of Alappuzha town on NH66. Nearest major airport: Cochin International Airport (approximately 80–100 km by road). Use local taxis or buses to Vandanam; confirm directions with the hospital before travel.
etiquette: Confirm department OP days, emergency contact numbers and referral documents before travel.
Carry original medical records and scans when attending for specialist appointments.
Respect hospital visiting hours and follow infection‑control guidance (masks when asked).
If you are accompanying a patient, plan parking/transport in advance — campus is large and blocks are spread out.
